title: M10/M11 admin routes never wired to API Gateway (deployed unreachable)
description:
All M10 job-management routes (DELETE /admin/jobs/{hash}, POST .../regenerate,
POST .../retry, POST /admin/jobs/bulk-delete) and the M11 GET /admin/costs
route were implemented in cdk/lambdas/router/handler.py and covered by
extensive moto-based Lambda-level tests, but were never added to the CDK
HttpApi route table in cdk/stacks/backend.py. The Lambda handler itself
correctly dispatches on these paths, but API Gateway had no route entries
for them at all, so every one of these endpoints 404'd in production
despite passing 100% of automated tests.

Root cause: cdk/tests/test_router.py and test_router_cost_reconciliation.py
invoke the handler function directly with synthetic API-Gateway-shaped
event dicts, bypassing the actual CDK-synthesized HttpApi routing entirely.
No test exercised route registration, so a missing add_routes() call was
invisible to the whole review process across ~20 sub-agent dispatches.

Discovered during first production deploy of M11 (2026-09-16): `auritus
cost --daily` returned `404 {"message":"Not Found"}` against the live API,
which led to inspecting cdk/stacks/backend.py's route list and finding the
five missing entries.

Fixed directly (not via sub-agent) in cdk/stacks/backend.py by adding:
  GET    /admin/costs
  DELETE /admin/jobs/{hash}
  POST   /admin/jobs/{hash}/regenerate
  POST   /admin/jobs/{hash}/retry
  POST   /admin/jobs/bulk-delete
to the authenticated route group, and re-deployed to production
(AuritusBackend stack). Verified via `auritus cost --daily` and
`auritus job show` returning 200 instead of 404 post-deploy.

Follow-up worth considering (not done here): an integration-style test that
asserts every route the router handler dispatches on actually has a
corresponding add_routes() entry in the CDK stack, so this class of gap
can't recur silently.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Fixed and deployed to production. Verified auritus cost --daily and auritus job show return 200 (not 404) post-deploy.
